verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is API-first. Every scraping option (JS scenarios, extraction, proxies, screenshots, markdown, auto mode) is an API parameter. The dashboard's visual Request Builder only configures those same API requests, a Usage API exposes credit and concurrency data, and the Postman collection claims to cover 'every ScrapingBee's features'. However, no source explicitly states that the API matches the UI, and account and dashboard management (API keys, billing, settings) via the API is not documented. missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, API coverage of account/key/billing management, OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can also discover this API using our Postman collection covering every ScrapingBee's features
